title: Smoke on the Wind
story:
Leaving the roadside produce stand behind, James and Nico pushed south along the dry, dusty shoulder of the highway as the midday heat pressed heavily against the valley. Suddenly, a sharp shift in the wind brought a stinging scent of scorched grass and dry stalks, and a dark plume of dense smoke began to billow across the ripening sugarcane fields ahead.

Driven by the fast-spreading brush fire leaping through the roadside scrub, James scooped the small deer mouse onto his shoulder and turned away from the open highway. They scrambled up a steep, thorny embankment toward the massive, moss-covered stone blocks of an ancient aqueduct cutting across the valley floor, seeking a barrier against the advancing flames.

The wind howled over the open masonry, carrying glowing embers and a thick grey haze that stung their eyes. Moving swiftly along the narrow top of the stone watercourse, James and Nico braved the billowing smoke, keeping low against the weathered blocks as the sharp crackle of the fire grew louder behind them.

Dropping down the far side of the stone structure, they tumbled past heavy, broad leaves into a damp, protected banana grove away from the smoke. Safe beneath the cool, moisture-heavy canopy, James caught his breath while Nico shook the grey ash from his fur, listening to the muffled roar of the fire safely dying out against the high stone wall behind them.
location: A damp, protected banana grove near the ancient stone aqueduct
